AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

16. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Making Tacking Stitches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Fuel Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Wild Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
